Explain the important implementation choices, invariants, and trade-offs. Link

## Verification

- [ ] Formatting check passes
- [ ] Lint passes without warnings
- [ ] Strict type checking passes
- [ ] Automated tests pass
- [ ] Production build passes
- [ ] Relevant browser behavior was checked

List the exact checks performed and explain anything that was not applicable.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Files and functions have cohesive responsibilities
- [ ] Names are descriptive and domain-specific
- [ ] Comments explain rationale and remain consistent with the code
- [ ] External inputs are validated at their boundaries
- [ ] Important behavior and regressions are tested
- [ ] Test names and comments explain the protected behavior, scenario, and proof
- [ ] No unrelated changes, secrets, placeholders, or dead code are included
- [ ] Documentation and decision records are current
